query:
INSERT INTO campaign_queue (searchId, companyId, userId, companyName, jobType, status)
SELECT c.searchId, c.id, 1, c.name, 'full', 'pending'
FROM companies c
WHERE c.searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
AND (c.salesApproachData IS NULL OR c.salesApproachData = '')
AND c.id NOT IN (
  SELECT companyId FROM campaign_queue 
  WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003) 
  AND status IN ('pending', 'running')
);
